'''Cabin 522''' was a room in the [[Taupe Corridor]] on the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Reasonable Doubt]]''. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] occupied the room during a mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]] in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="dr">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>
